item.title: Conduit v4.1.7
item.description:
Conduit 4.1.7 | conduit
## What's Changed * Add iOS native Barge in toggle by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/737 * Support Open WebUI 0.11.4 and fix user-settings clears by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/748 * Fix native dropdown crash, composer overflow artifact, and stale streaming state by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/749
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.6...v4.1.7

item.title: Conduit v4.1.6
item.description:
Conduit 4.1.6 | conduit
## What's Changed * Collapse raw reasoning tags client-side and stop re-escaping stored content by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/731 * Fix attachments, STT, TTS, citations, proxy re-auth, and Hermes probe by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/732 * Keep chat scrollbar thumb stable and inset it from the composer by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/734
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.5...v4.1.6

item.title: Conduit v4.1.5
item.description:
Conduit 4.1.5 | conduit
## What's Changed * Fix native toolbar, Apple gating, streaming cadence, and wakelock regressions by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/718 * Fix ten reported issues and vendor Hermes Agent as an API reference by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/725 * Support Open WebUI shared folders by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/726 * Upgrade all packages, add notification settings link and Ollama thinking replay by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/727
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.4...v4.1.5
